description: Hire an AI employee (for example a Social Media Manager) that works on a schedule inside this workspace. Pass `template` and optionally name, instructions, products (the string all, or a list of product ids; appId is deprecated), schedule, monthlyBudgetCredits, maxCreditsPerRun, approvalPolicy and notify (channels, and recipients: hirer, admins or member user ids). The first call changes nothing and returns a preview and a confirmationToken; show it to the user, and call again with confirm: true and the token only after the user explicitly agrees — never confirm on the user's behalf. A subscription quote also returns a hireId: send it back unchanged with confirm: true and the confirmationToken, with the same template, level and currency, because the token is bound to that hireId and a confirm without it only gets a new quote. Public actions (publish, email, reply, listing or price changes) wait for the user's approval unless autopilot is turned on. The hiring user is billed for runs, up to the monthly budget. No cost to call. Use when the user wants recurring work done on a schedule by an AI employee.

appId.description: Deprecated: same as products:[appId]. Do not send together with products.

currency.description: Subscription hires only: the currency to pay in, before the account's first payment; ignored once it is billed in one. Leave it out unless the user asks.

hireId.description: Subscription hires only: the hireId the quote returned. Leave it out to get a quote; send it back unchanged with confirm: true. Retrying with the same hireId never hires twice.

instructions.description: Standing instructions from the customer (tone, topics to avoid, ...).

language.description: BCP-47 tag of the language the employee works and writes in, e.g. fr or pt-BR. Defaults to en. Ask the user rather than guess.

level.description: Subscription hires only: the level to hire at; the lowest one on sale when left out.

notInFrance.description: Only for a template that is not offered in France (the Bookkeeper) while the workspace has no country set: true once the user has confirmed their business is not based in France. Never set it without asking them.

products.description: "all" (every product, including ones added later) or a list of product ids the employee covers.

name: hire_employee

hireId.description: Subscription hires: send it back unchanged with confirm: true and the confirmationToken.

title: Hire Employee
